description: Discover which figures a company's record holds and what it calls them. Without `query`: standard_figures maps each standard figure (revenue, net income, EPS, cash, debt and the rest) to the name THIS company's record gives it (Apple's revenue is total_net_sales, JPMorgan's is total_net_revenue), and other_figures holds every remaining figure grouped by its statement or table (segments, revenue_by_* breakdowns, key metrics, bank and insurance tables, non-GAAP measures), keyed by path, with its values. With `query`: only the fields whose names contain every word ('data center', 'cet1', 'comparable sales', 'backlog', 'subscribers'), plus the standard figure the words name, if any. Every name and path returned can be passed to get_figure exactly as written. `block` limits to one table. A listing defaults to the latest fiscal year and latest quarter, a search to every period in the latest record; pass `period` for others.

block.description: Only this table, e.g. income_statement, reportable_segments, key_metrics.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

query.description: Words to find in field names, e.g. 'data center revenue'. Omit to list everything.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: list_company_figures
title: Every figure a company reports, by its own names
